text:
Varnholt Logistics named Ilse Marrenkamp chief executive in March, replacing interim boss Daren Vosk after a three-month search. The appointment took effect on March 18, with the company citing the need to tighten margins and speed up depot automation. Marrenkamp joins from Brannic Freight, where she ran European distribution and cut operating costs by 8% over two years.

Varnholt said first-quarter revenue rose 6% to 412 million kronor, helped by higher contract renewals and stronger warehousing demand. Net debt fell to 1.1 times EBITDA. Marrenkamp’s first priorities are route consolidation and a new pricing system due in July.

For the logistics sector, the move signals a continued shift toward operators with experience in automation, cost control and network redesign.
